title: OpenBSD sealed-brick bounded control surface
description: OpenBSD sealed-controller appliances must keep a bounded read-only collection surface, deterministic authority ceiling, and explicit UNKNOWN behavior for missing required evidence. Required by the Omnia Tribunal product requirement that normative semantics be explicit, not inferred from prose.
rationale: A narrow observable surface reduces accidental exposure and keeps rollback and evidence paths inspectable. Future Tribunal models must NOT reason from prose about whether DNS/pf is probably safe; they must resolve obs-ob-v0-collect-* through the declared decision rule.

expressions.message: v0 bounded collection observations are required preconditions for this invariant.

fail_if.message: v0 bounded collection gate returned non-PASS result.
v0 bounded collector did not declare expected contract/output mode.

unknown_if.message: Required bounded collection result observation is missing; Tribunal must never guess PASS.

error_if.message: Bounded result and output-mode declarations contradict each other (e.g. PASS result with non-public-minimized mode).

outcomes.pass_semantics: v0 bounded read-only surface was exercised and emitted a PASS verdict under the declared public-minimized contract. Normative policy satisfied.
outcomes.fail_semantics: The bounded collector returned FAIL/ERROR, or its emitted contract/output mode does not match v0 policy. Evidence required; do not auto-remediate.
outcomes.unknown_semantics: At least one required observation is missing. Tribunal must not guess PASS; operator either re-requests bounded evidence or explicitly accepts UNKNOWN disposition.
outcomes.error_semantics: Observations contradict each other. Surface as ERROR; escalate to human; never promote to PASS silently.

forbidden_actions.action: pfctl -f <candidate> on a live routing appliance
forbidden_actions.reason: Omnia invariants never decide live load; operator must apply last-known-good with explicit human gate.

forbidden_actions.action: rcctl set/enable/start/stop on live service state
forbidden_actions.reason: Live service state mutation outside Omnia's advisory-only authority ceiling; operator-only.

forbidden_actions.action: Add permit egress rule outside explicit playbook approval envelope
forbidden_actions.reason: Must not widen policy to compensate for FAIL/UNKNOWN without operator explicit decision.

explanatory_notes: Human prose rationale: This invariant models the sealed-brick's most basic posture contract. Future Tribunal models must NOT reason from prose about whether DNS/pf is probably safe; they must resolve obs-ob-v0-collect-* through the decision rule above.
